errorBoundary.title: This view ran into a problem
errorBoundary.body: The error has been logged. The rest of ReadAware keeps working — you can try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Details are in the app log.
errors.fsNotFound: A file ReadAware needs is missing.
errors.fsPermission: ReadAware doesn't have permission to access a needed file.
errors.fsNoSpace: The disk is full. Free up space and try again.
errors.dbLocked: The local database is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.dbError: The local database ran into a problem.
errors.secretsUnavailable: The credential store can't be opened, so keys can't be saved or read.
errors.aiNotConfigured: AI isn't set up yet — add an API key to start chatting.
errors.aiAuth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.aiRateLimited: The AI provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.aiQuota: Your AI account is out of credit or quota. Check your provider account.
errors.aiNetwork: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your connection and try again.
errors.aiProvider: The AI provider had a temporary problem. Try again shortly.
errors.aiContextOverflow: This request is too large for the model.
errors.aiUnknown: The AI request failed. Details are in the app log.
errors.syncNetwork: Can't reach the sync server. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncServer: The sync server is temporarily unavailable. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncRateLimited: Syncing is being rate-limited. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncUnauthorized: Your sync session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.syncMisdirected: The sync server address answered as a different service. Check the relay URL.
errors.syncPassphrase: The end-to-end encryption passphrase doesn't match.
errors.syncTransportUnavailable: The plugin providing this sync connection isn't available. Enable the plugin, then try again.
errors.syncTransportMismatch: The sync plugin's server settings changed after connecting. Reconnect to adopt the new server.
errors.localSaveFailed: This change couldn't be written to local storage and may be lost after a restart.

crashPrompt.title: ReadAware had a problem last time
crashPrompt.body: Sending a diagnostics report helps get it fixed.
